notes: A holdout must be ONE_SHOT_HOLDOUT with exact lane/league/model_version/endpoint/baseline_version/baseline_definition_ref, validated_families, and separate passing paired-logloss CI gates for each family. An opened development evaluation cannot qualify. Shadow count/duration is derived from unique retained receipt hashes with pregame timing and matching code/model scope. Every shadow receipt additionally binds baseline_version, baseline_definition_ref and baseline_code_artifacts. Review does not make legacy or reconstructed forecasts prospective.
